lessons_learned.lesson: Standalone evaluation lock cards occupying dedicated lateral grid space cause severe page imbalance and visual fragmentation. Housing Defense Evaluation & Grade Sign-Off inside Section 4 of Capstone1CollapsibleSections (default collapsed) eliminates clutter while preserving full access to rubric scores, criteria breakdowns, and panel sign-off locks. Extracting the canonical right sidebar into ProjectInformationSidebar guarantees 100% information parity between student and faculty/instructor views.
lessons_learned.prevention: Never hardcode duplicate sidebar widget compositions between student and faculty project views; maintain a single canonical ProjectInformationSidebar component accepting capability flags (canManage, canManageArchive).
